name: eco-speed benchmark
description: Code, benchmark instances, per-run experiment logs and analysis for the paper "Separating distance and fuel-intensity effects in a controlled comparison of metaheuristics for emission-aware vehicle routing". The archive eco-cvrptw-benchmark-v1.1.zip contains the solver for the emission-aware capacitated vehicle routing problem with time windows (E-CVRPTW) with eco-speed, eco-speed versions of the 56 Solomon instances, the per-run output of every experiment reported in the paper (5,430 runs, including the municipal case study), the analysis scripts and their output, and the logs of the original submission. Supplementary Data S1 to S8 of the paper are included as separate files. The README describes every file, the protocol, the software versions, and what is and is not reproducible exactly.
